# Ethan Allen Mails Letter to Shareholders Detailing its Highly Qualified Nominees and Executable Growth Plan


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_fb7b58ef482dabe5cd1e24780d1ad47f/ethanallen/news/2026-10-12_Ethan_Allen_Mails_Letter_to_Shareholders_325.pdf) October 12, 2026 6:00am EDT


***Urges Shareholders to Vote “FOR” Ethan Allen’s Five Nominees, Whose Experience is Directly Aligned with the Company’s Strategy on the BLUE Proxy Card***


*Changing the Board During an Active CEO Transition Creates Unnecessary Risk*


*DGB Has Not Presented an Executable Financial Plan or Capital Allocation Strategy to Support Its Promise to Triple Shareholder Value*


*Visit*[www.VoteEthanAllen.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RU_Gy2K0e68C9z0BPv0KkQo7tAAvPAyhjcmw4izhwKcNvUeubt8GQL3ddspUEk9Qbhm1Nw3XCTxbR1NhrpW32hzCu4bDv5sRGvfagmpWrke8SeL4pcZgJz00bCMi6xh8nOZwdfVyg7ENGbwmdRNIB-2RHk7wOqfjsGssd7UHcBcVVrQ_fX-TUIriix517hD5-WK0sI39Y2qNx5LaIJRpalRRO5CRgBQnkumNxuh-SU7t_DVksCjq_X3xtpCzyhTQKRuk0We5TjrchdnZP_3ZhQ==) *for More Information*


DANBURY, CT, Oct. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. (“Ethan Allen” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ETD), a leading interior design company, manufacturer and retailer in the home furnishings marketplace, today shared a letter from the Company’s Board of Directors (the “Board”) to all shareholders in connection with the Company’s Annual Meeting of Stockholders (“Annual Meeting”), scheduled to be held at 11:00 A.M. Eastern Standard Time on November 4, 2026. Shareholders of record as of the close of business on September 11, 2026, are entitled to vote at the Annual Meeting.


The Company’s Board is sending shareholders the letter below, which highlights the following key points:


- DGB seeks control of the Company with promises of tripling shareholder value but has not presented an operating plan or a capital allocation strategy to substantiate its claims of growth.
- Ethan Allen has not shut its “digital front door” but has rather deployed online designer appointments, live chat, 3D floor planning and other digital tools that help clients connect with the Company’s personalized design services.
- Ethan Allen’s independent directors are currently working with a nationally recognized search firm on a CEO transition. Changing the Board now would transfer oversight of both the business and the CEO search to five newcomers during an active leadership transition, creating unnecessary execution risk.
- DGB says its nominees have been “held accountable for results.” Shareholders should scrutinize the adverse results documented in the letter during selected periods of nominee service: declining revenue at Grove, declining shareholder returns at Cable One, both at Wayfair, and a restatement and SEC action at VeriFone.
- Ethan Allen is a debt-free, vertically integrated manufacturer-retailer, and its nominees bring the directly relevant skills: global operations, manufacturing, design-center real estate, brand and digital marketing, finance, and governance. DGB has not demonstrated comparable experience overseeing the full complexity of Ethan Allen’s vertically integrated operating model. It is critical that Ethan Allen Shareholders vote “ **FOR** ” the Company's five highly qualified nominees and vote “ **WITHHOLD** ” on DGB’s nominees on the **BLUE** proxy card.


*The full text of the letter being mailed to shareholders follows:*


**Ethan Allen Shareholder Letter on Board Leadership and Growth**


Dear Fellow Shareholders,


Ethan Allen has substantially completed a major repositioning: refreshing and right-sizing more than 100 design centers, consolidating logistics and expanding digital capabilities while preserving profitability and a debt-free balance sheet. Record close rates and higher order values show progress, and an independent CEO search is underway.


DGB is asking you to give their nominees control of the business and the CEO selection without a CEO and no operating plan, while simultaneously lauding the work done by your Board and leadership team.[1](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=fyQPqmCsEHidAEMHfeFWfpB6XrP81ZfuQdqKDtY_ysFQw3TvKqvsKijPnzFDmubhfsB5UZuFlKEiiXZcwt577P_NUfz_Jdj7JLe9n6kb6UF_rwbGOFQj8B_FTX_ZwNlGf1SzMsQGRttH3N0wE8wRc9PiBoq48aDpteJBrU4v_yMqEnZos3CJ-lxCYMU05cIj) ,[2](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BubrZr_qFCkX_iKZDDUNGhlktaeBgXKBlKawb2fWxPIBw1RCLLjf7WdBczmGag2Ajnf5bLkXz1-OZJTZAJv14Aaf-WkZqSQEYbyBIr8E9z7TsaqyCFymLkthSgYJYDSlbluVVeQIbgHMKjE0d-Rr4NMZYk-uVpmlh9iuE6-_jvo=)


Mr. Bergeron himself recognizes Ethan Allen’s iconic brand, national retail footprint and domestic manufacturing advantage. Ms. Brockway acknowledges its quality and craftsmanship, while Ms. Ward recognizes that the company’s foundation is already there.[3](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=v1HM341GfGhS2JESkEEiaC6pQgO4c947G-J3mp9Y0GtGCb9wurAT7_XVRJlXS5Bdy_wTb1Kq6h6t00ny2ACJ-ycEMrpKzlLuKISOsACE16wYbptAkrzK-hhwh_zLIszUwj0u1ylaQ8W5WLUjJVTaKkW05YXTVB4Ahi2At31ip08=)


Your Board has delivered measurable progress, with record close ratios, higher order values, and gross margins above 59% for five straight years, and is focused on turning that momentum into sustained, profitable growth. Your Board is best positioned to oversee the business and the CEO selection. Vote FOR the Company's nominees on the BLUE card today, and discard any card you receive from DGB.


*DGB has not presented an executable financial plan or a capital allocation case*


DGB proposes brand revitalization, a stronger omnichannel customer experience and greater investment in growth, promising significant shareholder upside within 24 to 36 months. But claiming the potential to triple shareholder value is not an operating plan.[4](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=uEI9HvSozXG5u98uTRSEMO6kC6QlNhNhBchOTlXyr10dH_ySQ4CWAP93WzXLeb8EwnNy11AvnGz2btF46S9-XI0aa19h6YPv_4S77sOH1qcXh0LtUIIfJm64v4d7ajdRSxodljjvJ1HHDHyMWXt4VA==) The table below shows Ethan Allen’s executable plan and what DGB leaves unanswered. **Our Nominees’ Experience is Directly aligned with the pillars of Ethan Allen’s strategy**
